input.title: torch.compile crashes with InternalTorchDynamoError when an OrderedDict is mutated concurrently
input.body:
`torch.compile` crashes with an `InternalTorchDynamoError` when an `OrderedDict` argument is concurrently mutated while TorchDynamo is constructing its symbolic representation.

The corresponding eager execution succeeds.

The failure occurs with `backend="eager"`, which suggests the issue is in Tor
